selection: Reuse the existing three 4-layer circular baseline runs (100 tokens). Train uniform_extra and resonance (132 tokens each) with identical 320938 parameter backbone, same shared Conv10, absolute center/span encoding and extra-token indicator. Fixed input-only SG11/poly3, prominence 0.01, distance20; at most two valleys, 16 tokens/window, total window span four half-prominence widths clipped to 16..240 original grid intervals; no-valley fallback is uniform32; single-valley second window is uniform16. Original R is never smoothed or locally depth-normalized. These rules are frozen before validation. All three seeds use identical initialization and training recipe. Replacement requires >=1% lower mean joint-mirror validation MSE than the current baseline, length MSE at most +2%, dX MAE +5%, dY MAE +2%. Attribute benefit to valley selection only if resonance also beats matched uniform_extra mean validation MSE by >=1% with the same dimension safeguards. Otherwise report that mechanism unestablished. Minimum eligible validation MSE wins, median-validation seed retained; freeze before test.
test_policy: Only existing baseline and validation-frozen winner evaluated on the same previously inspected 100 test IDs, each with three seeds. No test-guided reselection. This is repeated test comparison, not a new blind test. Sample207 is fixed only for inference and sampling illustration, not window tuning.
quality_scope: Corrected generator2 2.2.0, thick SiO2 / passive JC Au100 / As2Se3; 1000 samples fixed 800/100/100; metal-only 8nm pipeline_validation. Inverse tokenization study only. No new FDTD, no forward network, no fabrication guarantee. Linear interpolation adds no underlying spectral resolution.
